lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor thirty-one. A hundred and four megawatts. Be advised there's a korrite seam under the deck plate — that's why this one got funded.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: So the other thirty were charity.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The other thirty were strategic. This one pays for the other thirty.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Ion lance is cleared. Thirty-four megawatts, and it reaches across four lanes from the middle of this board — that's what you're buying, not the damage.
lines.beat: names the lance's real differentiator: reach, not damage per megawatt

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Understood. Everyone watch the footing, the deck's been cut open.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. They're routing round the seam, not through it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They won't cross the cut. Why won't they cross the cut?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Because we made it. They only have routes for what was here when the order was written.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Somebody's already taken about nine tonnes out of this seam. The cut faces are old.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ours?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Not ours.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The lance is heavy on the bus. You're over — everything's firing slower to pay for it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. Seam's intact.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ring first. The rock can wait.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Ring's plated. Nothing gets in — and nothing waiting out there decided to leave. It's queued, not gone.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Fine. I'd rather pick the moment.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: That's a clean run. Don't get used to it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Good work. Survey team's inbound for the seam.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, the seam's been worked. Old faces, clean cuts, not Ordinal.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Understood. Survey team's still inbound.
lines.beat: Control does not engage — the first time the chain of command is visibly not telling them something

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's a no, then.
